title: A novel engineered nanoherbicide: improving performance, efficiency and sustainability of herbicide bentazon
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,4211-4221
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00195A, Paper
Open Access

Alessandra Azzali, Cristina Miguel-Rojas, María C. Alcántara-Braña, Belén Parra-Torrejón, Gloria B. Ramírez-Rodríguez, Fabrizia Grepioni, Alejandro Pérez-de-Luque, José M. Delgado-López
A new nanoherbicide using bentazon (Btz), a widely used post-emergence herbicide, was developed to considerably reduce the required dosages without compromising its efficacy.
